title: Cops Find Teen Strangled After She Called 911 on Her Mom
description:
A Florida mom is facing a first-degree murder charge in connection with the strangulation death of her 18-year-old daughter. Police took Rotesha Silveus, 38, into custody after her daughter, Natavia Sanders, 18, called 911, saying she “just woke up from passing out,” and was “strangled” by her “mom.” Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
